text: This is a B1 text about pets. In modern society, pets plays a surprisingly significant role. Although some people might dismiss it as trivial, the impact of pets on our daily lives is undeniable. For instance, when we consider how much time and resources are devoted to pets, it becomes clear that it shapes our cultural landscape. Personally, I have found that engaging with pets has broadened my horizons and allowed me to connect with diverse groups of people.
